title: Sourcing Inquiry
description: A qualified sourcing inquiry submitted by an overseas buyer through the SSourcing China website.

user_id.description: Reference to the visitor who submitted the inquiry. Created/upserted in the system Users table first, then linked here.

name.description: Full name of the buyer submitting the inquiry.

email.description: Email address used to reply to the inquiry.

country.description: Country or region the buyer is based in.

product_category.description: Primary product category the buyer wants to source.

services_needed.description: Services the buyer wants the agent to cover for this inquiry.

estimated_order_value.description: Buyer's rough estimate of the order value, used to qualify the lead.

brief.description: Free-form project brief: product spec, target price, quantity, certifications, destination port, timeline.

source_page.description: Page path on the SSourcing China site where the inquiry was submitted (for attribution).

status.description: Internal sales-pipeline status. Starts at 'new' when submitted by a visitor.
